definitions.explanation: The cost of water usage from municipal water supply, typically paid bimonthly in Japan.

examples.japanese: {水道代|すいどうだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
{水道代|すいどうだい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧か{月|げつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一回|いっかい}→一回：08925_ikkai⟧です。
examples.english: The water bill comes once every two months.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{過|す}ぎで{水道代|すいどうだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The water bill got high from using too much water.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{水道|すいどう}→水道：01058_suidou⟧ (water supply/plumbing) + ⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧ (charge/fee). Refers to the cost charged by the municipality for water usage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水道代|すいどうだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay the water bill
- {水道代|すいどうだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{節約|せつやく}する→節約する：25226_setsuyakusuru⟧: to save on water costs
- {水道代|すいどうだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: the water bill is high

CULTURAL NOTE:
Water bills are typically paid bimonthly (⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧か{月|げつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一回|いっかい}→一回：08925_ikkai⟧}), unlike ⟦{電気代|でんきだい}→電気代：09543_denkidai⟧ (electricity) and ⟦ガス{代|だい}→ガス代：08943_gasudai⟧ (gas) which are monthly. The rate varies by municipality.

RELATED UTILITY COSTS:
- ⟦{電気代|でんきだい}→電気代：09543_denkidai⟧: electricity bill
- ⟦ガス{代|だい}→ガス代：08943_gasudai⟧: gas bill
- ⟦{光熱費|こうねつひ}→光熱費：08244_kounetsuhi⟧: utility costs (collective term)
- {水道代|すいどうだい} is also called ⟦{水道|すいどう}{料金|りょうきん}→水道料金：22703_suidouryoukin⟧ in official contexts
